section1.title: But first... why did I decide to do it?
section1.subtitle: TRAVEL FOR FREE

life_in_spain.title: Life in Spain
life_in_spain.sentence: What is it like to live there?

hero.title: CHALLENGES
hero.subtitle: The difficulties I faced during my experience

health.title: HEALTH
health.subtitle: Intestinal virus and period at the same time
health.description: A nightmare that kept me in bed while everyone else was having fun. The nostalgia in those moments was very strong.

loneliness.title: LONELINESS
loneliness.subtitle: Far from family
loneliness.description: Seeing others with their visiting parents was hard. I felt alone in those moments, especially when I was sick.

thought.title: The Thought
thought.text: "Anyway, my host parents don't have the school app, they won't see if I'm absent."

fact.title: The Fact
fact.text: Two days off to go to the center and do whatever I wanted.

reality.title: The Reality
reality.text: They caught me immediately. I risked having to go back to Palermo early and pay out of my pocket.

food.title: FOOD
food.text: I didn't adapt. Used to Palermo, eating here was sad.

money.title: MONEY
money.text: I ran out three times. I don't know how, but it disappeared.

palermo.title: PALERMO
palermo.text: Everything happened there. I knew I would miss parties and outings.

safe.title: Safe
safe.description: Walking around at night without worries.

colorful.title: Colorful
colorful.description: Clean and cared for in details.

cleanliness.title: Obsessed with Cleanliness
cleanliness.description: No joke. Extremely clean city and obsessed with recycling. Containers everywhere, separated by colors.

weather.title: The Weather
weather.description: Always sunny. Literally rained only 3 times the whole period. On December 10th people were swimming in the sea.

flood.title: The Flood
flood.description: There was a critical moment: an incredible flood. Luckily I wasn't in Alicante! I was in San José in a hotel with pool, so I narrowly escaped while the city was underwater.

castle.title: Santa Bárbara Castle
castle.description: The fortress that dominates everything. Incredible views of the port and the sea.

port.title: Port of Alicante
port.description: Yachts, palm trees and postcard atmosphere. The Miami of Spain.

promenade.title: Explanada Promenade
promenade.description: Promenade with sea and port views.

el_corte_ingles.name: El Corte Inglés
el_corte_ingles.description: Fixed meeting point. One has luxury brands, the other (the house one) also has electronics.

gran_via.name: Gran Via
gran_via.description: Shopping center with stores, cinema and restaurants.

al_campo.name: Al Campo
al_campo.description: Need a car to get there. Inside there's Alcampo, many stores and various things.

zoo_benidorm.title: Benidorm Zoo
zoo_benidorm.description: Huge zoo that's very worth it, better than the city itself.

cabo_de_gata.title: Cabo de Gata
cabo_de_gata.description: Nature reserve. We saw the lighthouse, salt flats and beaches (Genoveses and Monsul).

san_jose.title: San José
san_jose.description: 3 days in hotel with pool. Beautiful white village. This is where I was saved from the flood.

spaniards.title: THE SPANIARDS
spaniards.subtitle: Things I have noticed
spaniards.physical: Let’s start with the physical aspect: almost all of them are slim (both boys and girls), but strangely most of them have a lot of acne.
spaniards.behaviorText: Almost all of them are very kind and very "party-loving". They love Italian music, it is super appreciated here! But there is something strange: on Saturday nights you hardly see anyone in the streets, honestly.
spaniards.schoolText1: Young people are very different from us. They always drink milk or milk with cocoa (like Nesquik).
spaniards.schoolText3: People are very attentive in class and do not disturb. However, if they have homework to do, for them the day is over: they never go out during the week (except on Fridays).

hostFamily.title: My Host Family
hostFamily.intro: With the host family I have spent a lot of time together. They have taken me practically everywhere!

paco.job: Accountant in a bus transport company
paco.description: With him I have a special relationship. He is very organized and loves talking about his job. Moreover, he is passionate about learning new languages and we often talk about the differences between Italian and Spanish. We have done a lot of things together:
paco.list2: We used to play cards at night (with Angelines)

angelines.description: As a teacher, she has a lot of patience and loves teaching. She is always willing to help with homework or explain any doubt I have. She is very caring and worries a lot about everyone at home.

sisters.title: The Sisters
sisters.luciaInfo: 19 years old - Studies at the University of Elche

hero.title: Living in Spain
hero.subtitle: The differences I noticed (Food, Houses and Transport)

food.title: Supermarkets and Food
food.point1: Prices: Some things cost much more, especially toilet paper and eggs.
food.point2: Meat and Chicken: Much thicker cuts and easier to chew.
food.point3: Milk: They have a dedicated section with stacked cartons like water.
food.point4: U.S. Products: Full of things that do not exist in our country (800 types of Milka, Doritos, Cheetos).
food.taste2: Sauce: Very sweet, it feels like it has sugar.
food.cook1: Pasta is cooked to be eaten 1 or 2 days later.
food.cook2: They do not cook the sauce: they pour it directly from the bottle (or small milk-like containers) onto the pasta.

transport.title: Public Transport: A Delight
transport.point1: Maximum efficiency: 100% electric buses and very frequent.
transport.point2: Stops: Almost always with seats, trash bin and a solar-powered screen showing waiting minutes.
transport.point3: Curiosity: The same bus has the same number but two different names depending on direction.
transport.ticket3: Passes: Rechargeable cards (no expiration) are bought in tobacco shops. They can be recharged there or on the bus.

house.title: House and Residence
house.house1: Water: Tap water is not good. We have two taps (one filtered) or use 6L bottles (they cost less than boxes).
house.house3: Fan: Almost every room has a ceiling fan that also works as a ceiling light.
house.house4: Bathrooms: Two bathrooms (one with shower, one with bathtub).
house.res2: Large swimming pool always full and clean.

schedule.title: Spanish Schedules
schedule.subtitle: Here people live with shifted hours:

hero.title: SPANISH SCHOOL
hero.description: The Spanish education system is completely different, with continuous written exams and no oral exams.

comparison_section.title: Comparison of Education Systems
comparison_section.subtitle: A visual analysis of the differences between the Italian and Spanish education systems

studies_duration.title: Duration of studies
studies_duration.description: In Spain you finish at 17-18 years, in Italy at 18 (with primina at 17)

primary_school.title: Primary School
primary_school.description: 6 years in Spain compared to 5 in Italy

after_middle_school.title: After Middle School
after_middle_school.description: In Italy you continue with upper secondary school, in Spain you choose between Bachillerato or Vocational Training

after_eso.title: After ESO
after_eso.description: Spanish students can choose between Bachillerato (2 years) for university or Vocational Training to enter the job market

dress_code.title: School Dress Code
items: Everyone uses Vans backpacks, practically mandatory
Most people have style, it's rare to see someone scruffy
Hard to find "canis" like in Italy
Many wear football shirts, even the girls
No imposed dress code, maximum freedom

race_for_seats.title: The Race for Front Seats
race_for_seats.description: Spanish students always try to sit in the first 3 rows, never at the back.

absences_lateness.title: Absences and Lateness
absences_lateness.subtitle: How attendance management works in Spain

music.title: The Soundtrack
music.description: Between classes, 5 minutes of music at full volume through the speakers. Sometimes they even play Pinguini Tattici Nucleari!

classroom_33.title: Classroom 33
classroom_33.description: During free periods I go to classroom 33. The key is picked up at reception.

id_card.title: The Card
id_card.subtitle: If you are 16 years old they give you this card to go out during break.
id_card.description: There are concierges who check at the door. You show it and can go out during breaks (and come back in), or go straight home if you have finished classes.

prsi.title: PRSI - Basic Computing
items: They do things we did in first year, but it was compulsory and I couldn't drop it.
Windows computers with various operating systems available

fp_subjects.title: 3 Vocational Training (FP) Subjects
items: All similar to Systems and Networks and TeP
In two of them, SIOM and SERED, they were more advanced than us.
The third, RELO, they were doing things we did last year

grades_and_spelling.title: Grades & Spelling
grades_and_spelling.penalty: 0.10 points are deducted for each spelling mistake.

study_methods.title: How you study here
study_methods.math: Basically you have to know everything by heart, there are no more calculations like in Italy.
study_methods.chemistry: Get ready to memorise a lot of theory, especially nomenclature.
study_methods.note: Basically, if in Italy they asked you to understand, here they want you to know everything by heart.

Inglés.name: English
cons: 12+ exams divided into Reading, Speaking, Grammar, Writing, Listening

Lengua Castellana.name: Spanish Language
Lengua Castellana.description: I started very badly with the subject because we had exams with rhetorical figures and analysis of some verbs and words, as well as text summaries and various things. Then I understood the rhetorical figures and recovered at the last moment.

bathrooms.title: How the bathrooms work
bathrooms.procedure_title: Procedure to go to the bathroom:
first_building: Bathrooms only on the ground floor
Boys and girls bathrooms next to each other

tutoring_and_representatives.title: Tutoring and Representatives
tutoring: One weekly hour dedicated to class wellbeing
Space to discuss problems and find solutions together
notebooks_and_agenda: 0.5 extra points for notebook order (single notebook, divided by subject)

physical_education.title: Physical Education
physical_education.Ringo_Ball: Like football, but you can also use your hands.
physical_education.volleyball_intro: We split into teams and each member, when not playing, must evaluate an opponent on:
Volleyball_exam: Technique and response to the ball
physical_education.Running_exam: Progressive duration: starts with 5 minutes in the first year of ESO and increases by 5 minutes each year, up to 35 minutes in 2nd year of Bachillerato.

excursions_and_trips.title: Excursions & Trips
excursions_and_trips.class_excursions: They are very boring things like catching flies on a mountain to then observe them better in the biology laboratory.
excursions_and_trips.study_trips: Teachers propose various trips during the year. Interested students can apply and participate by paying the established fee.
